changes: Added playbook_candidate_ingest and wired DONE settlement to non-blocking done-experience candidate ingestion; documented the automatic seed-to-candidate boundary and opt-out flag.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js playbook_candidate_ingest --json for dry-run, add --apply to create proposals/candidates, or let DONE settlement trigger story-scoped ingestion by default.
expectedOutcome: DONE story experience can be observed and automatically transformed into candidate playbooks without activating them or recording helped outcomes from DONE success alone.
actualTranscript: Focused smoke passed 18/18; playbook_candidate_ingest dry-run reported proposed done-experience candidate ids without writing active playbooks; done_prepare validation passed after merging main.
outcomeDiff: No functional difference from expected; activation remains intentionally evidence-gated and separate from candidate creation.
limitations: Historical bulk backfill and evidence-based activation are intentionally out of scope for this story; this story proves automatic DONE experience to candidate ingestion only.
pitfalls: Main sync changed materialHash, so final quorum and DONE evidence had to be recorded after done_prepare. Candidate ingestion must remain non-blocking and must not treat DONE success alone as helped.
